scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with finite-cycle reproducibility checks; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Gross-work process only, before erasure and other feedback costs.
Fixed-parameter sharp local law requires 0<p<1/2 and 0<q<1; odd-cycle zero-work probability is identically zero.
Gaussian crossover holds for fixed p as q approaches one; no uniform joint p limit or full conditional path law asserted.
Close antecedents include the exact original propagator and generic Markov-additive large-deviation theory.
title: Sharp zero-work return asymptotics and a symmetry-restoring rare trajectory for a lazy quantum engine
